newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI 9 '96 net profit falls to PLN 4.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI 9 '96 net profit falls to PLN 4.2 mln.

text.p: The National Investment Fund No. 9 in Poland's mass privatisation scheme saw its net profit fall last year to 4.2 million zlotys from 9.5 million in 1995, the fund said in an issue prospectus.
Under the government's NFI programme, shares in about 500 mid-sized companies are allocated to 15 NFIs run by foreign and domestic management firms.

From May 12 the 26 million Poles who bought a participation unit in the scheme will have the opportunity to exchange it for 15 shares, one in each fund, which are expected to start trade on the Warsaw bourse around mid-year.
The units lose their validity on December 31, 1998.
